nodes.label: Parser
nodes.desc: Mutex-guarded wrapper around hclparse.Parser that caches source buffers so diagnostics can render code snippets.

nodes.label: LoadHCLFile
nodes.desc: Branches on extension: ParseJSON for .tf.json files, native ParseHCL for everything else.

nodes.label: LoadConfigDir
nodes.desc: Loads a whole config directory into a Module, rejecting duplicate variable, resource or output definitions.

nodes.label: IsConfigDir
nodes.desc: Cheap precondition check that a directory actually contains .tf or .tf.json files before a full load.

nodes.label: Module
nodes.desc: Decoded module contents: variables, resources, outputs, locals and module calls in one struct.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.desc: One node of the module tree; its Children map links each module call name to a child Config.

nodes.label: ModuleWalker
nodes.desc: Interface that resolves each ModuleRequest to a loaded child module while the tree is assembled.

nodes.label: FinalizeConfig
nodes.desc: Post-load pass that resolves provider types and validates provider configuration blocks.

nodes.label: PlanGraphBuilder
nodes.desc: Holds config, prior state, root variable values and the plugin library; builds graphs for plan-like operations.

nodes.label: Steps()
nodes.desc: Operation-dependent transformer list: 32 steps from ConfigTransformer through TransitiveReductionTransformer.

nodes.label: BasicGraphBuilder
nodes.desc: Runs the transformer steps in order, then validates that the result is an acyclic graph.

nodes.label: ConfigTransformer
nodes.desc: Creates graph nodes for every resource and module call present in the desired configuration.

nodes.label: StateTransformer
nodes.desc: Adds nodes for current and deposed instance objects found in the prior state so they can be planned.

nodes.label: ReferenceTransformer
nodes.desc: Analyzes expressions across the config to wire dependency edges between graph nodes.

nodes.label: TransitiveReductionTransformer
nodes.desc: Drops redundant edges so the rendered graph shows only direct dependencies.

nodes.label: ApplyGraphBuilder
nodes.desc: The apply twin: builds from an approved plan and prior state instead of raw configuration.

nodes.label: Graph
nodes.desc: Embeds dag.AcyclicGraph plus the ModuleInstance path that this graph belongs to.

nodes.label: Graph.Walk
nodes.desc: Visits vertices with full parallelism, logging the start and completion of each visit.

nodes.label: GraphWalker
nodes.desc: Interface with EvalContext, scope enter/exit and Execute callbacks invoked around each vertex.

nodes.label: EvalContext
nodes.desc: Interface giving nodes expression evaluation, provider schemas and guarded state access.

nodes.label: nodeExpandPlannableResource
nodes.desc: DynamicExpand turns one resource block into a subgraph of AbsResourceInstance nodes per count/for_each instance.

nodes.label: NodeAbstractResource
nodes.desc: Shared resource-node logic: schema attachment, config decoding and the plan-diff helpers.

nodes.label: NodePlannableResourceInstanceOrphan
nodes.desc: Concrete node for state instances whose configuration vanished, planned for removal or forgetting.

nodes.label: State
nodes.desc: Top-level state: a Modules map keyed by module address, plus root outputs and check results; mutated only via accessors.

nodes.label: SyncState
nodes.desc: Mutex wrapper exposing atomic higher-level operations over a State during concurrent walks.

nodes.label: ResourceInstance
nodes.desc: Holds the Current object plus any Deposed objects pending cleanup from create_before_destroy replaces.

nodes.label: ResourceInstanceObjectSrc
nodes.desc: Flat, serializable instance object keeping attributes as raw JSON with a status field.

nodes.label: statefile.Read
nodes.desc: Sniffs the on-disk format version, reads v4 directly and upgrades the legacy v0-v3 layouts.

nodes.label: VersionedPlugins
nodes.desc: Maps protocol versions 5 and 6 to their provider and provisioner gRPC plugin sets.

nodes.label: Handshake
nodes.desc: go-plugin handshake config: TF_PLUGIN_MAGIC_COOKIE key/value pair and minimum protocol version 4.

nodes.label: Serve
nodes.desc: Launches the plugin server over a DefaultGRPCServer so the Terraform CLI can dispense providers.

nodes.label: GRPCProvider
nodes.desc: Core-side client implementing providers.Interface: ReadResource, PlanResourceChange and ApplyResourceChange over gRPC.

nodes.label: Context.Plan
nodes.desc: Public entry point producing a plan from one config/state pair, handling moves, imports and targets first.

nodes.label: planGraph mode switch
nodes.desc: NormalMode builds the full plan graph; RefreshOnlyMode sets skipPlanChanges; DestroyMode plans only deletions.
